copy.headline: Crash report details how Fort Worth CEO, two children were killed the night before Thanksgiving
copy.caption: Zach Muckleroy, the CEO of Muckleroy & Falls construction company in Fort Worth, and his children, Judson and Lindsay, died in the crash, his company said.
